_header: Copy this file to <your-model>.json next to your install. 3 EDITS, every path absolute:
1. "exe": your engine exe (after setup: engine-hyper\hyper.exe inside your install folder).
2. "args" "--model": your model .gguf file. Keep "--max-context" 131072 unless setup told you otherwise.
3. "vision" (optional): your .mmproj file for pictures; delete the whole "vision" block for text-only.
Start it with run-model.example.bat (copy it too). Proof it runs: http://127.0.0.1:8080/health says loaded:true.
